description: VEPL is a labelled aerial-image dataset for vegetation encroachment along power-line corridors. Universidad Nacional de Colombia researchers publish RGB image tiles and matching multiclass masks derived from a commercial UAV survey along a rural road. Zenodo provides four ZIP archives under CC BY 4.0 for free access. The 2023 dataset can train monitoring models whose vegetation observations become inputs to outage-risk or maintenance simulations. Coverage is limited to the surveyed corridor, and tiling, augmentation and manual labels affect how independent training and test samples should be chosen. It does not contain measured outages or electrical clearances. The acronym is unrelated to the VEPL price measure in data-industrial-energy-prices-48-countries-1995-2015; no matching catalogue dataset was found.
